library(thinkthen)
body <- c("I was billed twice for one order.",
  "My parcel is a week late.",
  "I am locked out of my account.")
teams <- c("billing", "shipping", "account")
# each ticket goes to the team its words name
data.frame(body, team = tt_choose("Which team owns this?",
  body, teams))
# only the double bill is about money, so it ranks first
tt_rank("Is this about money?", body, top = 1)
